purpose: Test whether the one pre-existing causal Absolute Market State can remove genuinely negative opportunity from the new fixed ranks-3-to-5 Champion without searching market dimensions or cells.

fixed_state.definition: Compound the daily cross-sectional median PIT-valid stock step return over the 20 completed sessions ending at the decision close.
fixed_state.normalization: Exact causal expanding-prior LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH state already emitted by Cycle-019; no recomputation or threshold change.
fixed_state.why_selected_before_join: It was Cycle-019's only STRONG_APPLICABILITY_INFORMATION single dimension, with favorable early and late spreads. Dispersion, synchronization, persistence, and every 2D cell are prohibited.

anatomy.population: Exact frozen ranks 3, 4, and 5 trades grouped equally by original signal date.

frozen_translation.authorization: Only if both anatomy gates pass.
frozen_translation.rule: If exact Absolute Market State is LOW at the weekly decision close, open no new ranks-3-to-5 cohort; otherwise execute the exact ranks-3-to-5 strategy.
frozen_translation.existing_positions: Never changed; retain exact due-open and forced corporate-action exits.
frozen_translation.cash: Skipped cohort allocation remains cash; no redistribution, leverage, hedge, or later backfill.

prohibited: MEDIUM-only, HIGH-only, continuous scaling, synchronization, dispersion, persistence, or 2D state rules
state threshold, lookback, normalization, direction, or timing changes
rank-set, weight, holding, exit, cost, or industry changes
OOS, independent-validation, confirmation, live, or production claim
